name: Lost Property
tagline: Recovers money owed to you through official unclaimed-property programmes
description: Guides you through the official state unclaimed-property portals so funds already owed to you actually get claimed. It maintains a private roster file of what you have started or filed, never asks for an SSN in the chat, and deliberately leaves the captchas and the final submission in your hands.
